source.method: Disassembly listings from ghidra-cli 12.1.4 and Capstone 5.0.7 were treated as leads. Every instruction sequence, table and string under staticChecks is confirmed against the pinned bytes by tools/verify_sound_effect_triggers.py --exe.

soundPlayerAction.slot3Target: interface slot 11 (0x00548560), whose body is a bare ret 4 that pops one stack argument, called with the FileNumber
soundPlayerAction.boundary: Slot 3 of the action reaches no sound call. The interface method it calls pops its argument and does nothing else.

pendingRequest.rule: A request replaces the held one when its priority byte is greater than or equal to the held byte (unsigned). An empty cell holds priority 0.
pendingRequest.frameUpdateEffect: A pending file number other than -1 is played through 0x004bbb00 with the volume, then the file number is set to -1 and the priority to 0. A pending -1 skips both and keeps the held priority.
pendingRequest.boundary: Other methods of the class could read the index and the vector. Only the frame update was read.

playPath.volumeGate: A volume above zero skips the first module call. A volume at or below zero calls module slot 8 (0x00442050) with the resource id first. The play call follows either way.
playPath.slot8: Looks the resource id up in the module cache map at module +0x18 and, when it is absent, allocates a 0x28-byte object before continuing. The rest of the method was not read. The call is not a play.
playPath.categoryRoles: Categories 3 to 20 hold files the character creation menus play. Category 2 and category 21 have no traced consumer.

entryClasses.method: Direct-call reverse closure over a call graph built from Ghidra function bounds and Capstone. Each class listed owns a virtual method that reaches the entry through direct calls. Indirect calls are not followed.

literalIdNote: A scan of the executable sections for the little-endian pattern 0x035b0000 plus a 16-bit value below 10000 finds 25 byte matches. The seven listed ids are the push and add immediates. The other matches are parts of other instructions and addresses. File number 59 reaches category 0 index 59 through 0x004bbb00 and is not an immediate resource id.

footstepComposers.note: Pure id composers with the same arithmetic as the footstep play entry. A rel32 call and jump scan of the code section finds no caller of either.

messageSound.position: The sound is played at the position of the actor that 0x004d9970 returns for the entry target id.
messageSound.recordShape: The entry count is the u16 at record +0x30. Entry k starts at record +0x38 plus 0x14 times k. The target is its first dword and the message id is the u16 at +0x44 plus 0x14 times k.
messageSound.boundary: The record kinds that reach 0x0058ca80, the opcodes that stage them and the capture frequency of message ids 0x846e and 0x8475 were not enumerated.

drainFilter.skipsWhen: the flag at stack +0x158 is clear, the selector at stack +0x14 is not -1 and the entry byte at +0x47 differs from the selector
drainFilter.boundary: The sources of the flag and the selector were not traced.

prePlayCall.boundary: The effect of the call was not read.

messageSound.nullActor: A null actor from 0x004d9970 skips the play and the function still returns true.

reachability.method: Walk over direct call and jump targets. The call graph uses the function bounds of the Ghidra export and Capstone 5.0.7 over the pinned bytes.
reachability.boundary: Virtual and indirect calls are not followed. The receive dispatcher reaches CharaElement slot 9 through a virtual call (xivl-decomp:docs/actor/action-queue.md).

appearancePhase.numberRule: number = table value + (random value mod 12), played through 0x004bbb00.
appearancePhase.key: The key is the u32 at +0x29c of the argument. The store at 0x00862cb9 writes an array index there for an object taken from an array at +0x1c8. Whether that object is the argument of slot 22 was not traced.
appearancePhase.random: A generator object built by 0x00459dc0 from the result of the import called at 0x0085e99c and read through 0x00459e00.

listMenu.idRule: resource id = idTable[6 * group + position], where group is the first dword of the selected row and position is the index of the selected id among three row entries.
listMenu.requestObjects: Three per-menu request objects at this+0x3f1c with a stride of 0x18.
listMenu.boundary: The row table extent beyond 15 rows, the list the rows belong to and the meaning of position 3 are not established.

claims.claim: SoundPlayerAction has FileNumber, Index, Volume and Priority with the defaults 0, 0, 1.0 and 0 at this+0x44, +0x4c, +0x54 and +0x5c.
Running the action calls interface vtable slot 10 with FileNumber, Index, Volume, the vector (0, 0, 0, 1) and Priority.
The interface lives in the global 0x0135c2ac, written by the base constructor and the destructors and read only by the getter 0x00974220.
Slot 10 keeps a request when its priority is at least the held priority and stores file number, index, volume, vector and priority.
The constructor starts the cell at file number -1, index 0, volume 0, vector (0, 0, 0, 1) and priority 0.
The frame update plays a pending file number through 0x004bbb00 with the volume and then stores -1 and priority 0.
A pending -1 skips the play and both clears.
The frame update runs once per Application::Rapture update through 0x004daa10.
The frame update reads the file number and the volume only.
0x004bbb00 divides the file number as an unsigned value by 10000 and passes the quotient as the category and the remainder as the index.
The category table at 0x00f8d700 holds 22 base ids and 0x004b7470 indexes it with no bound check.
A volume at or below zero first calls module slot 8 with the resource id.
The module keeps three request objects from 0x0132f384 with a stride of 0x18. The music request indexes them with a selector and every sound effect entry uses the third.
The play is module vtable slot 4 on the shared request object 0x0132f3b4 with the resource id, the volume and the vector (0, 0, 0, 1).
Categories 0, 1 and 2 hold 83, 110 and 425 files, categories 3 to 20 hold 55 files each and category 21 holds 1 file.
Decoded markup holds 1012 SoundPlayerAction elements in 200 template files.
Every markup FileNumber lies from 1 through 82, inside category 0.
Two driver configuration texts differ only in the VOICE bus number and carry MAX_SOUND 128, 11 buses and STRINGENDO_FADE_TIMES of 4500.
A configuration value of 4 or 5 after the decrement selects the text with VOICE 0. A zero key value keeps the result of 0x004055d0 in its place.
The meaning of the per-bus numbers.
Literal category 0 resource ids are indexes 12, 14, 15, 16, 49, 55 and 56.
The call sites of the eight play entry functions are those listed under entries.
The role of each caller follows from its class name and its resource id source.
The result record drain plays 0x035b0037 for message id 0x846e and 0x035b0038 for 0x8475 at the target actor position for each non-empty entry that passes the selector filter.
The drained records come from Map clientbound packets staged by CharaElement slot 9.
No direct call path from the receive dispatcher body reaches an SE entry.
AppearancePhase slot 22 maps ten keys to numbers 30021 through 200021 and adds a random remainder modulo 12.
The list menu reads resource ids from a table of ten rows of six.
The keys and groups select voice sample banks for creation previews.
No in-world voice trigger or voice id to category rule was traced.
No consumer of category 2 or category 21 was found.
The installation holds 770 files below data/08/07 and 45 below data/1A/46.
Command triggers named UILuaCommands.SoundPlay can start actions from script.
0x004b7790 plays only when InterlockedExchangeAdd on 0x0132f3cc with addend 0 returns 1, and A9 is the sixth slot 4 argument of its first play.

The drain skips an entry when the flag at stack +0x158 is clear, the selector at stack +0x14 is not -1 and the entry byte at +0x47 differs, and 0x005859f0 calls 0x007969d0 on actor +0xe0c before each play.

boundaries: Which forms and templates use each FileNumber, and which runtime event fires them, is not mapped beyond the trigger kind counts.
Volume 100 on two markup actions is passed through as a float and the client unit is not established.

The module getter 0x004d7500 has 31 call sites. Functions 0x00588f60, 0x006a60e0, 0x006a8e80, 0x006ad410, 0x006b2ac0, 0x0085ffb0, 0x00860050, 0x00865980, 0x00875980, 0x00886610 and 0x008866e0 were not traced to a sound play.
Module slot 4 callers that hold their own request object were found only through the getter census and an immediate scan.
Resource id sources of 0x0084ff50 and 0x007cf100 callers were not traced to clip data.
The composition roles of the footstep arguments are not decoded.
Bus assignment, 3D placement and the SCD priority switch were not traced into the sound driver.
The writers of the footstep gate flag 0x0132f3cc, the sources of the drain filter flag and selector, the effect of 0x007969d0 and the default returned by 0x004055d0 were not traced.
